segments.title: A Failed Investment
segments.content:
Among the five subjects in the middle school entrance exam, the language paper was likely the kind where a perfect score was impossible, even if one knew all the questions beforehand.

Not only was it hard to get full marks on the essay, but for questions like reading comprehension, even the original author might not be able to get a perfect score, let alone Li Luo.

But even so, with his memory palace, Li Luo had a huge advantage.

After all, for questions like multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blanks, he had the answers prepared long ago and could write them down as soon as he got the paper.

This saved him a lot of time, allowing him to tackle the reading comprehension and essay with more ease.

As such, even for the language paper he was least confident about, Li Luo was sure he could aim for a three-digit score.

Compared to his previous self who could only score in the seventies or eighties, wasn't this a sure thing?

However.

"You've only finished one exam, what's there to be sure about?" Lin Xiuhong beckoned and said, "Hurry home. Have Xixi help you review math again. Your dad and I are going back to cook."

"Xiuhong, leaving already?" Zhang Xuefen had also picked up her son by then and walked over with him. "Chunchun, this is your cousin-auntie and cousin-uncle, and your older cousin. Go say hi."

Li Luo looked at his younger cousin, Wei Chun, and saw him offer a polite but helpless greeting. He then looked at Zhang Xuefen and frowned slightly.

"Yes, we need to hurry home and cook," Lin Xiuhong replied. "You should take Chunchun home to rest soon, too. The kids have another exam this afternoon."

"Right, you guys go ahead." Zhang Xuefen smiled faintly, pretending to be reserved. "My Old Wei dotes on me, insisted on hiring a nanny to cook. Now I'm so bored at home every day with nothing to do."

Li Luo looked at Zhang Xuefen, speechless, then quickly took his mom's hand and walked forward. "Mom, I'm hungry, let's go home. Goodbye, Cousin-auntie!"

But they had only walked a block when a red Audi sped up from behind. The window rolled down to reveal Zhang Xuefen's smiling face. "How about I give you a ride?"

"No, no, we'll be there after the next intersection."

"Alright then, see you this afternoon."

Watching the red Audi drive away, the family walked home in silence.

Ying Chanxi followed them inside, then quickly pulled Li Luo into his bedroom, letting out a small sigh of relief.

"Who was that auntie? The way she talks is so annoying."

The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. "A show-off cousin-auntie. My mom's mortal enemy, I guess?"

When Lin Xiuhong was young, she was the belle of the village.

She was pretty from a young age, sensible and obedient, and the only girl from the village to get into the town's junior high school.

Although Zhang Xuefen was also good-looking, she was often overshadowed by Lin Xiuhong. Whenever people talked about the young girls in the village, Lin Xiuhong always came out on top.

After graduating from junior high, Lin Xiuhong apprenticed with an old tailor in the village and quickly inherited his skills, earning a lot of money.

Many families would look for Lin Xiuhong first when they wanted new clothes made for the New Year or other festivals.

At just seventeen or eighteen, Lin Xiuhong was already a wealthy young woman in the village. She used the money she earned from tailoring to buy a small shop, and her business flourished.

In comparison, Zhang Xuefen lagged far behind.

So when she later got lucky and married a good husband, Zhang Xuefen couldn't help but show off for a bit whenever she saw Lin Xiuhong.

Of course, if it were just that, it wouldn't be a big deal.

But Zhang Xuefen's appearance reminded Li Luo of another related matter, and his expression darkened slightly.

Still, the middle school entrance exam came first. It was best to focus on that for now.

…

"Where are your politics and history textbooks?"

After lunch and a short nap, Ying Chanxi came into Li Luo's room to ask.

Li Luo rummaged through his school bag and pulled out a few books.

After flipping through Li Luo's textbooks, Ying Chanxi sighed, exasperated. "What is all this..."

The politics and history class for junior high students in Yuhang City combined subjects like ethics, history, and politics into one.

The total score was only 50 points, and it was an open-book exam.

But Li Luo's textbooks were almost completely covered in all sorts of strange doodles.

Some unimportant pages had even been torn out to be folded into paper airplanes.

Although it was an open-book exam, there was still a huge difference between one person's textbook and another's.

"Ahem... They're usable," Li Luo said, feeling a bit embarrassed looking at the childish drawings.

But for a 35-year-old man, history and armchair politics were one of the few joys in his daily life.

Even without an open-book format or his memory palace, politics and history was definitely his strongest subject.

But Ying Chanxi clearly didn't think so.

She tossed Li Luo's textbooks aside, ran back to her own home, and returned a moment later with a few books, which she stuffed into Li Luo's hands.

"Here, just use mine."

A set of beautifully kept textbooks, mostly protected by plastic covers, landed in Li Luo's arms.

He looked down and flipped through them.

The neat and delicate handwriting inside was a pleasure to look at.

The page edges were marked with colored tabs, with dynasties and key points written on them. When needed, he could just flip to the right spot to find the information he needed.

It was much more convenient than using the table of contents.

Li Luo looked at the textbooks in his hands, then at the tattered ones on his desk, and without hesitation, he stuffed Ying Chanxi's books into his school bag.

"Then I won't be polite."

…

Five in the afternoon.

The bell rang, signaling the end of the third exam, politics and history.

Li Luo walked out of the exam hall and saw his dad, Li Guohong, standing in the shade of a tree not far away, chatting with someone.

Lin Xiuhong and Ying Chanxi were at home cooking dinner and hadn't come. They had seen Li Luo after his math exam and then gone home to buy groceries.

So only Li Guohong was waiting for him.

And at this moment, besides Li Guohong, there were also Cousin-auntie Zhang Xuefen and Cousin-uncle Wei Dongrong.

"Right, a ten percent annual interest."

"With such high interest, why are you coming to me?"

"We're family, aren't we? Of course I'd bring you in on a good project. In this day and age, have you ever seen anyone lose money in real estate?"

"Old Wei, you're the one making big money. My family runs a small business. We only have so much, and we need to save it for our son's house in the future. We really can't afford any risks."

"Ah, there's no rush. We're just talking about it for now. I can take you to see the project later. It's a guaranteed profit."

"Alright, I'll have to think about it. It's a lot of money, after all."

Li Luo walked up to Li Guohong, greeted his cousin-auntie and cousin-uncle, and vaguely overheard their conversation. He immediately frowned and discreetly sized up the other party.

Upon seeing Li Luo, Li Guohong paused the conversation, waved goodbye to Wei Dongrong, and started walking home with Li Luo.

"Dad, what were you guys talking about?"

"Nothing much," Li Guohong shook his head. "It's adult business. You just focus on your exams and don't worry about it."

Li Luo pouted helplessly. At only 15, he really didn't have much of a say in front of adults.

If it were a trivial matter, Li Luo naturally wouldn't bother with it.

But seeing Cousin-auntie Zhang Xuefen and that Cousin-uncle Wei Dongrong again, Li Luo was immediately lost in memories.

Back when he was in school, he was completely clueless about his family's financial situation.

It wasn't until two or three years after graduation, while having a drink and chatting with his dad, that he learned that around the time he started high school, his family had invested in a relative's real estate project.

At the time, they said the minimum investment was 100,000 yuan, with an annual interest of ten percent.

Although Li Guohong was tempted at first, his family had only managed to save about six or seven hundred thousand yuan after over a decade of running a breakfast shop and living frugally.

So he only invested 100,000 yuan for one year initially.

But when the year was up and he got back 110,000 yuan, having truly earned 10,000 yuan in interest...

Neither Li Guohong nor Lin Xiuhong could resist the temptation.

After all, if they had invested their entire 600,000 yuan a year ago, wouldn't that have been 60,000 yuan in interest?

That was several months' worth of extra income for nothing!

What happened next was, of course, a complete mess.

Wei Dongrong's main business wasn't real estate, after all. He had just gotten lucky and secured a piece of land through his connections.

His financial management and project planning were all over the place, a completely amateur operation.

The building was left unfinished, the company went bankrupt, and the money Li Luo's family had invested was stuck there. By the time he was 35, the legal wrangling was still ongoing, and over a million yuan in principal and interest had never been recovered.

Li Luo had been young back then and knew nothing about his family's affairs. His parents wouldn't have discussed such things with a little kid.

But now, having a second chance, Li Luo naturally couldn't let it happen again.

The only difficulty now was… how to make his parents believe what a 15-year-old kid had to say?

Li Luo had a bit of a headache.

Fortunately, there was still time.

His cousin-uncle had probably just run into Li Guohong today and started chatting.

The actual decision to invest wouldn't be made in a short time.

Li Luo sighed and didn't probe his father further. He decided to focus on acing the entrance exam first.

If he could at least get a better score, he would have more of a voice with his parents.

At the very least, he needed to let his mom and dad know that he had turned over a new leaf and was no longer that ignorant, mischievous, and rebellious brat from before.

…

When he got home, dinner was already on the table.

Li Luo watched as Ying Chanxi, wearing an apron, walked out of the kitchen with a plate of food. Her hair was tied up in a bun, and a faint sheen of sweat was on her forehead, making him feel a bit dazed for a moment.

He put his school bag back in his bedroom and went over with a few tissues.

Ying Chanxi took them, surprised, and dabbed her cheeks and neck simply before looking Li Luo over. "Since when did you become so considerate?"

"Just thanking you, that's all." Li Luo rolled his eyes, then returned to his usual self. "Your textbooks were very useful. Anyway, thanks a lot."

Although Li Luo had his memory palace, he really hadn't read through those politics and history textbooks completely even once.

So even if he wanted to access his memory, he might not be able to find the corresponding content.

Fortunately, the junior high politics and history exam was simple. With the help of Ying Chanxi's detailed, neat and tidy textbooks, Li Luo's exam went smoothly.

"You're welcome," Ying Chanxi said with a smile. "As long as you can get into a regular high school, I'll have repaid Auntie Lin for all her kindness to me."

"I think you can raise your expectations for me a little," Li Luo coughed twice, laying the groundwork. "For example…"

"For example, Yingcai? Or Shulan?" Ying Chanxi listed a few of the more well-known local regular high schools. "If you can get into No. 2 High, that would be very impressive."

"I think a person needs to have a dream," Li Luo said seriously. "Like the Affiliated No. 1 High?"

"Dreams are beautiful," Ying Chanxi patted his shoulder. "Keep it up, then. Let's eat first."

"If you can get into the Affiliated No. 1 High," Lin Xiuhong, who was bringing out bowls and chopsticks, chimed in, overhearing Li Luo, and let out a chuckle. "I'll agree to buy you that smartphone you wanted before."

"Mom, why don't we forget it? I can pretend I didn't hear you," Li Luo sat down at the table and said with a straight face. "Smartphones are so expensive right now. I'd feel bad making you spend so much."

"Shut up and eat," Lin Xiuhong slapped the chopsticks down in front of him. "If you have what it takes to get into Affiliated No. 1 High, what condition wouldn't I agree to?"

"Then I have only one condition. Promise me you'll be gentler with me in the future. That way you'll age slower."

"Get lost."
